calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  ds.region,
  ds.format,
  SUM(rds.net_sales) as net_sales,
  SUM(rds.receipts) as receipts,
  SUM(rds.units_sold) as units_sold
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON rds.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE rds.business_date >= '2025-08-25' 
  AND rds.business_date <= '2025-09-21'
  AND ds.store_id < 900  -- exclude pseudo-stores/web
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, ds.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 50

  ds.store_name,
  ds.region,

  AND ds.is_current = TRUE
  AND ds.store_id < 900
